en.bilal-muhammad: Prayer is broken by wind (i.e. flatulence) when it comes out from the prayer, or other than it of what breaks the wudu, or that he remember that he is not upon wudu, or he finds an injury, or a [severe] wound for which it is not possible for him to endure it, or a nosebleed that a lot of blood comes out from his nose, or he turns until he sees whoever is behind him.
Nothing breaks the prayer of the Muslim that passes before him of a dog or a woman or a donkey or [anything] other than that.
